overall_insight: APAC 권역의 자사 베이스라인 국가. 3대 기관 트리플A·외국인 100%·외환 자유로 진입 게이트는 전부 PASS다. 시장 구조의 핵심 차별점은 Toyota의 부동의 1위와 novated lease(급여공제·FBT 연동 리스) 채널의 독특한 발달 — 단순 오토론 복제로는 시장 핵심을 놓치므로 salary-packaging/FBT 연동 상품 모듈이 결정적 성공요인이다. 면허는 소비자신용=ACL(ASIC, 약 150일 인가)이 핵심 관문이나 B2B chattel mortgage는 National Credit Code 적용제외(무면허)라 세그먼트 비대칭이 단계적 진입의 출발점이다. 비즈니스 매력도(안정·고소득)는 상위권이나 add-on insurance deferred sales(2021.10.5, 4일 의무유예)·anti-hawking 규제가 보험 부가수익 모델을 사실상 차단하는 핵심 리스크 플래그. 2025년 NVES 연비규제 + EV FBT 면제가 맞물려 EV+novated 결합상품이 가장 빠른 성장축이며 EV 잔가 곡선과 ABS 프라임 풀 관리가 손익의 핵심 변수다.
overall_insight_en: The APAC regional baseline country. Triple-A from all three agencies, 100% foreign ownership, and free FX make all entry gates PASS. The structural differentiator is Toyota's unchallenged #1 position and the uniquely developed novated lease (salary-sacrifice, FBT-linked) channel — a plain auto-loan copy misses the market core, so a salary-packaging/FBT-linked product module is the decisive success factor. On licensing, consumer credit (ACL via ASIC, ~150-day authorisation) is the key gate, but B2B chattel mortgage is excluded from the National Credit Code (unlicensed) — this segment asymmetry is the starting point for phased entry. Business attractiveness (stable, high-income) is upper-tier, but add-on insurance deferred sales (commenced 5 Oct 2021, 4-day deferral) and anti-hawking rules effectively block tied insurance revenue — a key risk flag. With the 2025 NVES efficiency standard plus the EV FBT exemption, EV+novated bundles are the fastest-growing axis; EV residual curves and ABS prime-pool management are the key P&L variables.

items.source: RBA Financial Aggregates / AFIA Auto Finance Data 2025
items.source_en: RBA Financial Aggregates / AFIA Auto Finance Data 2025
items.insight: 호주 자동차 금융 시장 약 €32bn. 신차 ~120만대·고차량가(ute/SUV 편중)·높은 금융침투로 권역 최대급. novated lease·chattel mortgage가 잔액의 핵심.
items.insight_en: Australia auto finance market ~€32B. New cars ~1.2M, high vehicle prices (ute/SUV skew), and high penetration make it one of the largest in the region. Novated lease and chattel mortgage anchor the balance.

items.source: AFIA / IBISWorld Australia Auto Finance 2025
items.source_en: AFIA / IBISWorld Australia Auto Finance 2025
items.insight: 2021~2025 CAGR 약 5.3% — 성숙시장 안정 성장. EV+novated 전환과 차량가 상승이 견인, 인하 사이클로 신규 수요 회복.
items.insight_en: ~5.3% CAGR over 2021-2025 — stable growth of a mature market. Driven by EV+novated shift and rising vehicle prices; the rate-cut cycle revives new demand.

items.source: RBA / ABS / IMF WEO 2025
items.source_en: RBA / ABS / IMF WEO 2025
items.insight: 2025년 실질 GDP 약 2.0% — 선진국 평균 수준 안정. 이민 기반 인구성장·자원수출이 하방 지지.
items.insight_en: Real GDP ~2.0% in 2025 — stable at advanced-economy average. Migration-led population growth and resource exports provide downside support.

items.source: AFIA / Industry research 2025
items.source_en: AFIA / Industry research 2025
items.insight: 신차 약 62%가 금융 조달 — 캡티브 프로모·novated lease·딜러금융 주도. 현금 구매 비중도 상당.
items.insight_en: ~62% of new cars financed — led by captive promos, novated lease, and dealer finance. Cash purchases remain material.

items.source: Industry research / Pepper Money·Plenti disclosures 2025
items.source_en: Industry research / Pepper Money, Plenti disclosures 2025
items.insight: 중고차 금융 약 40% — 비은행·핀테크(Pepper·Plenti·Wisr) 주력 세그먼트. 위험기반 가격으로 마진 우위.
items.insight_en: Used-car finance ~40% — the core segment for non-banks and fintechs (Pepper, Plenti, Wisr). Risk-based pricing yields margin advantage.

items.source: RBA Cash Rate / Canstar Car Loan Comparison 2025
items.source_en: RBA Cash Rate / Canstar Car Loan Comparison 2025
items.insight: 신차 secured 비교금리 평균 약 8% (RBA cash rate 3.6~4.1% + 마진). 프라임 ~6%, 니어프라임·핀테크 두 자릿수 중반.
items.insight_en: New-car secured comparison rate ~8% (RBA cash rate 3.6-4.1% + margin). Prime ~6%, near-prime/fintech in the mid-teens.

items.source: FCAI VFACTS 2025
items.source_en: FCAI VFACTS 2025
items.insight: 2025년 신차 약 120만대 — 2024 역대최고(122만) 후 소폭 조정. ute·SUV 편중으로 여신 단가 큼. Toyota 부동의 1위.
items.insight_en: ~1.2M new cars in 2025 — slight pullback from the 2024 record (1.22M). Ute/SUV skew keeps ticket sizes high. Toyota the unchallenged #1.

items.source: AFIA / NALSPA Novated Leasing Data 2025
items.source_en: AFIA / NALSPA Novated Leasing Data 2025
items.insight: 소비자 할부론 + novated lease(급여공제 리스) + B2B chattel mortgage 다층 구조. novated lease가 호주 고유의 발달 채널 — 진출 핵심.
items.insight_en: Multi-layered: consumer loans + novated lease (salary-sacrifice) + B2B chattel mortgage. Novated lease is the uniquely developed Australian channel — central to entry.

items.source: Industry estimate (Toyota Finance·VWFS·premium captives) 2025
items.source_en: Industry estimate (Toyota Finance, VWFS, premium captives) 2025
items.insight: 캡티브(Toyota Finance·VWFS·Mercedes/BMW FS) 약 35%. 4대 은행 소비자 딜러금융 부분 후퇴로 캡티브·비은행 비중 확대.
items.insight_en: Captives (Toyota Finance, VWFS, Mercedes/BMW FS) ~35%. With the big-four banks partly retreating from consumer dealer finance, captives and non-banks gain share.

items.source: Industry estimate (no official AU auto-finance share statistics) 2025
items.source_en: Industry estimate (no official AU auto-finance market-share statistics) 2025
items.insight: 상위 5개사 약 50% 추정 — 호주는 회사별 공식 점유율 통계 부재. 캡티브·은행계·비은행 분산 구조로 집중도 중간.
items.insight_en: Top 5 ~50% (estimated) — Australia has no official per-company share statistics. Captive/bank/non-bank dispersion gives moderate concentration.

items.source: ATO / PwC Australia Tax Summary 2025
items.source_en: ATO / PwC Australia Tax Summary 2025
items.insight: 법인세 30%(대기업 기준). 연매출 AUD 5천만 미만 base rate entity는 25%. 선진국 중 다소 높은 편.
items.insight_en: Corporate tax 30% (large companies). Base rate entities under AUD 50M turnover pay 25%. Relatively high among advanced economies.

items.source: ATO Withholding / Korea-Australia DTAA
items.source_en: ATO Withholding / Korea-Australia DTAA
items.insight: 비거주자 이자 원천징수 10% — 한-호주 조세조약과 동일. 본사 차입 구조 비용 예측 용이.
items.insight_en: Non-resident interest WHT 10% — matching the Korea-Australia DTAA. Predictable cost for HQ-funded structures.

items.source: ATO / Korea-Australia DTAA / Franking Credit Rules
items.source_en: ATO / Korea-Australia DTAA / Franking Credit Rules
items.insight: 비거주자 배당(unfranked) 30%, 한-호주 DTAA로 15%. franked dividend(법인세 기납분)는 WHT 0% — 배당 효율 높음.
items.insight_en: Non-resident dividend (unfranked) 30%, reduced to 15% via Korea-Australia DTAA. Franked dividends (corporate-tax-paid) carry 0% WHT — efficient distributions.

items.value: 100% 허용 (FIRB 사전심사 대상). KAFTA 비국유 투자자 일반사업 심사기준액 약 AUD 1.34bn
items.value_en: 100% allowed (subject to FIRB review). Non-SOE investor monetary threshold under KAFTA ~AUD 1.34bn for general business.
items.source: Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Act 1975 / FIRB / Korea-Australia FTA (KAFTA)
items.source_en: Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Act 1975 / FIRB / Korea-Australia FTA (KAFTA)
items.insight: 지분 제한 없음, 단독 100% 진출 가능. 한-호 FTA로 상향 심사기준액 적용 — 신규설립·소규모 인수는 통상 승인. 실제 관문은 지분이 아니라 ACL 면허.
items.insight_en: No ownership cap; 100% solo entry feasible. KAFTA applies a higher monetary threshold — greenfield and small acquisitions usually clear. The real gate is the ACL licence, not ownership.

items.value: 외환통제 없음, 배당·이자 송금 자유. 이자 WHT 10%/배당(unfranked) 15%(조약). AUSTRAC 보고의무
items.value_en: No FX controls; free dividend/interest remittance. Interest WHT 10% / unfranked dividend 15% (treaty). AUSTRAC reporting required.
items.source: RBA (free FX) / ATO Withholding / Korea-Australia DTAA / AML-CTF Act (AUSTRAC)
items.source_en: RBA (free FX) / ATO Withholding / Korea-Australia DTAA / AML-CTF Act (AUSTRAC)
items.insight: 자본·배당 회수 자유로 킬스위치 통과. franked dividend는 WHT 0%. 송금 자체는 AUSTRAC AML 보고(국제이체 IFTI) 외 제약 없음.
items.insight_en: Free capital and dividend repatriation — killswitch passes. Franked dividends carry 0% WHT. Remittance itself is unconstrained beyond AUSTRAC AML (IFTI) reporting.

items.value: 강제 현지화 없음. Privacy Act 1988 APP 8(국외이전 책임주의). EU GDPR 적정성 미인정
items.value_en: No mandatory localization. Privacy Act 1988 APP 8 (accountability model for cross-border disclosure). No EU GDPR adequacy.
items.source: Privacy Act 1988 (APP 8) / Consumer Data Right (CDR) / OAIC
items.source_en: Privacy Act 1988 (APP 8) / Consumer Data Right (CDR) / OAIC
items.insight: 데이터 국내저장 의무 없음 — APP 8은 국외이전 시 수령자 준수를 이전자가 책임지는 모델. 한국 본사 클라우드 활용 가능(책임은 호주 법인 귀속).
items.insight_en: No domestic-storage mandate — APP 8 holds the transferor accountable for the recipient's compliance. HQ cloud usable, with liability resting on the Australian entity.

items.value: AAA (S&P, Stable) / Aaa (Moody's) / AAA (Fitch) — 3대 기관 트리플A
items.value_en: AAA (S&P, Stable) / Aaa (Moody's) / AAA (Fitch) — triple-A from all three agencies
items.source: S&P / Moody's / Fitch Sovereign Ratings 2025
items.source_en: S&P / Moody's / Fitch Sovereign Ratings 2025
items.insight: 세계 소수의 3대 기관 동시 AAA. 자본회수·송금 리스크 최저, 조달 신뢰도 최상 — 베이스라인급 안정성.
items.insight_en: One of few sovereigns with triple-A from all three agencies. Lowest capital-recovery/remittance risk and top funding credibility — baseline-grade stability.

items.value: 소비자신용=ACL(Australian Credit Licence, ASIC) 필요/외국사 취득가능. 일부 활동은 AFSL 추가. B2B/chattel mortgage=무면허
items.value_en: Consumer credit = ACL (Australian Credit Licence, ASIC) required, obtainable by foreign firms; AFSL for some activities. B2B/chattel mortgage = unlicensed.
items.source: NCCP Act 2009 / ASIC RG 204 / Corporations Act 2001 (AFSL)
items.source_en: NCCP Act 2009 / ASIC RG 204 / Corporations Act 2001 (AFSL)
items.insight: 외국사도 호주 등록법인 설립 후 ACL 취득 가능 — 국적 제한 없음. B2B 리스는 무면허로 즉시 영위 가능 — 단계적 진입의 출발점.
items.insight_en: Foreign firms can obtain an ACL after establishing an Australian-registered entity — no nationality bar. B2B leasing is unlicensed and immediately available — the starting point for phased entry.

items.value: 소비자신용=ACL 인가(ASIC 심사 약 150일, fit&proper). B2B chattel mortgage=National Credit Code 적용제외(무면허). novated lease=FBT 연동
items.value_en: Consumer credit = ACL authorisation (ASIC ~150-day review, fit & proper). B2B chattel mortgage = excluded from National Credit Code (unlicensed). Novated lease = FBT-linked.
items.source: NCCP Act 2009 s.29 + National Credit Code s.5/6 (business-purpose exclusion) / ASIC RG 204
items.source_en: NCCP Act 2009 s.29 + National Credit Code s.5/6 (business-purpose exclusion) / ASIC RG 204
items.insight: 영국(FCA) 체제와 구조적으로 유사 — 베이스라인 컴플라이언스 모듈 재사용성 높음. 결정적 차이는 B2B chattel mortgage가 Code 적용제외라 규제 부담이 현저히 가벼움.
items.insight_en: Structurally similar to the UK (FCA) regime — high reuse of baseline compliance modules. The decisive difference: B2B chattel mortgage is Code-excluded, so its regulatory burden is markedly lighter.

items.value: 소비자신용 연 48%(이자+수수료 all-inclusive) 상한 — 주(state) 단위. 비교금리(comparison rate) 의무공시. B2B 비적용
items.value_en: Consumer-credit 48% p.a. all-inclusive cap — at state level. Mandatory comparison-rate disclosure. Not applicable to B2B.
items.source: National Credit Code / state cost-of-credit caps (48% all-inclusive) / ASIC comparison-rate rules
items.source_en: National Credit Code / state cost-of-credit caps (48% all-inclusive) / ASIC comparison-rate rules
items.insight: 자동차 대출 표준금리(6~10%대)는 48% 상한과 무관 — 사실상 제약 아님. 비교금리 의무공시가 가격 투명성 규제의 핵심. B2B 신용은 상한 비적용.
items.insight_en: Standard auto-loan rates (6-10%) are far below the 48% cap — effectively no constraint. Mandatory comparison-rate disclosure is the core price-transparency rule. B2B credit is exempt.

items.source: NCCP Act general conduct obligations / ASIC RG 207 / Corporations Act (AFSL NTA)
items.source_en: NCCP Act general conduct obligations / ASIC RG 207 / Corporations Act (AFSL NTA)
items.insight: ACL은 고정 법정 최저자본금 없음 — ASIC 재무건전성·adequate resources 요건으로 대체. 진입 자본부담 낮음(영국 FCA 패턴). AFSL 동반 시 활동별 NTA 요건 발생 가능.
items.insight_en: ACL has no fixed statutory minimum capital — replaced by ASIC adequate-resources requirements. Low entry capital burden (UK FCA pattern). An accompanying AFSL may trigger activity-based NTA requirements.

items.value: Alfa Systems·NetSol·Solifi·Sopra Banking 등 글로벌 패키지 + 현지 SI. 대형 캡티브·은행은 자체 코어 혼재
items.value_en: Global packages (Alfa Systems, NetSol, Solifi, Sopra Banking) + local SIs. Large captives/banks mix in proprietary cores.
items.source: Industry research (AU asset finance core vendor ecosystem) 2025
items.source_en: Industry research (AU asset finance core vendor ecosystem) 2025
items.insight: 영어권·영국계 벤더(Alfa/NetSol) 생태계 공유 — APAC 베이스라인 자산. EU/UK와 동일 패키지군이라 권역 내 이식성 기준.
items.insight_en: Shares the English-speaking/UK-rooted vendor ecosystem (Alfa, NetSol) — the APAC baseline asset. Same package family as EU/UK, setting the regional portability reference.

items.value: 글로벌 패키지(Alfa/NetSol/Solifi) + 대형사 자체 코어, SaaS/클라우드 전환 진행
items.value_en: Global packages (Alfa/NetSol/Solifi) + large-player proprietary cores, with ongoing SaaS/cloud migration.
items.source: Industry (asset finance system modernization trends) 2025
items.source_en: Industry (asset finance system modernization trends) 2025
items.insight: 베이스라인 기준 — 패키지+자체 코어 혼재, SaaS 전환 진행. 권역 내 아키텍처 이식 기준점.
items.insight_en: The baseline — packages plus proprietary cores mixed, with SaaS migration underway. The reference point for regional architecture portability.

items.source: Industry (online application, e-signature, CDR Open Banking) 2025
items.source_en: Industry (online application, e-signature, CDR Open Banking) 2025
items.insight: 온라인 신청·비대면 성숙. CDR(Open Banking)이 영국보다 후발이라 API 개방도는 한 단계 아래. 전반적으로 선진권 4/5.
items.insight_en: Mature online application and remote contracting. CDR (Open Banking) is later than the UK, so API openness is a notch lower. Advanced overall — 4/5.

items.source: Equifax / illion / Experian Australia / Comprehensive Credit Reporting (CCR, 2018)
items.source_en: Equifax / illion / Experian Australia / Comprehensive Credit Reporting (CCR, 2018)
items.insight: 3대 CB(Equifax·illion·Experian) + 포지티브 신용정보(CCR) 의무 보고 체제로 성숙도 최상. 심사모델 이식성 높음 — 베이스라인급 5.
items.insight_en: Three CBs (Equifax, illion, Experian) plus mandatory positive reporting (CCR) make maturity top-tier. High model portability — baseline-grade 5.

items.source: NPP (New Payments Platform / PayID·PayTo) / BPAY / Direct Debit (BECS)
items.source_en: NPP (New Payments Platform / PayID, PayTo) / BPAY / Direct Debit (BECS)
items.insight: NPP 실시간이체·PayTo(신규 직불권한)·BPAY·Direct Debit 보편 — 수금 자동화 인프라 세계 최상위. 분할상환 자동징수 최적 5/5.
items.insight_en: NPP real-time transfers, PayTo (new direct-debit mandates), BPAY, and Direct Debit are ubiquitous — world-class collection automation. Optimal for installment auto-collection, 5/5.

items.source: Industry (carsales.com.au marketplace, dealer embedded finance) 2025
items.source_en: Industry (carsales.com.au marketplace, dealer embedded finance) 2025
items.insight: carsales 등 온라인 마켓플레이스 강력, 딜러 임베디드 금융 발달. 풀스택 온라인 판매는 다소 후발이나 선진 수준 4/5.
items.insight_en: Strong online marketplaces (carsales) and developed dealer embedded finance. Full-stack online sales lag somewhat but remain advanced — 4/5.

items.source: Privacy Act 1988 APP 8 (accountability model) / CDR rules
items.source_en: Privacy Act 1988 APP 8 (accountability model) / CDR rules
items.insight: 강제 현지화 없음, APP 8 책임주의로 국외 이전 허용 — 제약 낮음 2. EU 적정성 미보유라 EU 데이터 연계 시만 추가 안전장치 필요.
items.insight_en: No mandatory localization; APP 8 accountability permits cross-border transfer — low restriction, 2. EU adequacy is absent, so safeguards are needed only for EU data linkage.

items.source: National Credit Code Part 5 (default·repossession) / ASIC RG 205 (hardship)
items.source_en: National Credit Code Part 5 (default, repossession) / ASIC RG 205 (hardship)
items.insight: 소비자 신용은 Code 보호 강함 — default notice(약 30일)·hardship 대응 의무, 거주지 내 자력회수는 법원명령/동의 필요. B2B chattel mortgage는 Code 비적용이라 회수 용이 — 세그먼트 분기 필수. 종합 3(소비자 기준).
items.insight_en: Consumer credit is strongly Code-protected — default notice (~30 days), hardship obligations, and court order/consent required for at-home self-repossession. B2B chattel mortgage is Code-excluded so repossession is easier — segment branching required. Overall 3 (consumer basis).

items.source: Industry estimate (default notice 30d + hardship + repossession)
items.source_en: Industry estimate (default notice 30d + hardship + repossession)
items.insight: 소비자 신용은 default notice(약 30일) + hardship 검토로 약 2~3개월. B2B는 계약 즉시 회수로 단기. hardship 변수 존재.
items.insight_en: Consumer credit takes ~2-3 months (default notice ~30 days + hardship review). B2B repossesses quickly per contract. Hardship is a variable.

items.source: ASIC/ACCC Debt Collection Guideline / ASIC RG 96 / hardship rules
items.source_en: ASIC/ACCC Debt Collection Guideline / ASIC RG 96 / hardship rules
items.insight: ASIC·ACCC 공동 추심 가이드라인이 접촉빈도·시간·괴롭힘 금지 엄격 규율 + hardship 변경요청 대응 의무 강함(2024 강화). 추심·연체관리 컴플라이언스 공수 큼 4.
items.insight_en: The joint ASIC/ACCC collection guideline strictly governs contact frequency, hours, and harassment, with strong hardship-variation obligations (strengthened 2024). High collection/arrears compliance burden, 4.

items.source: AASB 9 Financial Instruments (full IFRS 9 adoption) / APRA APS 220
items.source_en: AASB 9 Financial Instruments (full IFRS 9 adoption) / APRA APS 220
items.insight: AASB 9 = IFRS 9 ECL 완전 동등 — 충당금 엔진 베이스라인 그대로 이식 가능 5. ADI는 APRA 추가 건전성, 비예금 금융사는 회계기준 중심.
items.insight_en: AASB 9 = IFRS 9 ECL fully equivalent — provisioning engine transfers as-is, 5. ADIs face additional APRA prudential rules; non-deposit lenders are accounting-standard-centric.

items.source: IFRS 9 / AASB 9 staging / APRA (ADI) / standard 90-day arrears
items.source_en: IFRS 9 / AASB 9 staging / APRA (ADI) / standard 90-day arrears
items.insight: IFRS 9 stage + 표준 연체분류(30/60/90일)로 NPL 엔진 베이스라인 호환 5.
items.insight_en: IFRS 9 staging plus standard arrears classification (30/60/90 days) keeps the NPL engine baseline-compatible, 5.

items.value: CTP(Compulsory Third Party) 자동차 책임보험 의무 — 주(state)별 상이(NSW Green Slip·VIC TAC·QLD 등)
items.value_en: CTP (Compulsory Third Party) liability insurance mandatory — varies by state (NSW Green Slip, VIC TAC, QLD, etc.).
items.source: State Motor Accidents/CTP statutes (NSW Motor Accident Injuries Act, VIC TAC, etc.)
items.source_en: State Motor Accidents/CTP statutes (NSW Motor Accident Injuries Act, VIC TAC, etc.)
items.insight: 차량 등록 시 CTP 가입 의무는 전국 표준이나 주별 제도·운영주체·요율 분절(NSW 민영 vs VIC 공영). 보험연동 로직 주별 분기 필요. 자동차금융 자체엔 게이트 아님.
items.insight_en: CTP is a national requirement at registration but fragmented by state in scheme, operator, and pricing (NSW private vs VIC public). Insurance-linkage logic needs per-state branching. Not a gate for auto finance itself.

items.value: ASIC deferred sales model(2021.10.5 시행) — add-on insurance(신용생명·CCI 등)는 주상품 판매 후 4 clear days 의무 유예 후 별도 판매
items.value_en: ASIC deferred sales model (commenced 5 Oct 2021) — add-on insurance (credit life/CCI, etc.) sold separately after a 4-clear-day deferral following the principal product.
items.source: Financial Sector Reform (Hayne Royal Commission) Act / ASIC RG 275 deferred sales model
items.source_en: Financial Sector Reform (Hayne Royal Commission) Act / ASIC RG 275 deferred sales model
items.insight: Hayne 왕립위원회 후 add-on 보험에 4일 의무 유예 — 차/대출 판매시점 동시 끼워팔기 금지. 끼워팔기 수익모델 사실상 차단, 보험 부가수익 설계 핵심 제약.
items.insight_en: Post-Hayne, add-on insurance carries a 4-day deferral — no tying at the point of vehicle/loan sale. Tied-revenue models are effectively blocked — a key constraint on ancillary insurance revenue.

items.value: Anti-hawking 강화(2021.10.5) — 비요청(unsolicited) 접촉 통한 금융상품 판매 금지. deferred sales model 병행
items.value_en: Strengthened anti-hawking (5 Oct 2021) — prohibits selling financial products via unsolicited contact. Runs alongside the deferred sales model.
items.source: Corporations Act 2001 anti-hawking amendments (5 Oct 2021) / ASIC RG 38
items.source_en: Corporations Act 2001 anti-hawking amendments (5 Oct 2021) / ASIC RG 38
items.insight: 비요청 권유판매 금지 + add-on deferred sales 이중규제로 보험 끼워팔기 영국(PPI 사태 후)보다도 엄격. 자동차 판매시점 보험 동시판매 모델 불가 — 별도 동의·시차·능동구매 경로 설계 필수.
items.insight_en: Unsolicited-sale prohibition plus add-on deferred sales make tied insurance stricter than the UK (post-PPI). No concurrent insurance sale at the point of vehicle sale — separate consent, time gap, and active-purchase paths are essential.

items.value: 전용 AI법 없음 — 분야별 원칙기반. Privacy Act(자동화 의사결정 투명성 개정 진행), ASIC 책임대출, 반차별법, AI Ethics Principles(자율)
items.value_en: No dedicated AI law — principles-based by sector. Privacy Act (automated decision-making transparency amendments in progress), ASIC responsible lending, anti-discrimination law, AI Ethics Principles (voluntary).
items.source: Privacy Act 1988 (2024 ADM transparency amendments) / ASIC RG 205 / Australia AI Ethics Principles
items.source_en: Privacy Act 1988 (2024 ADM transparency amendments) / ASIC RG 205 / Australia AI Ethics Principles
items.insight: EU AI Act 같은 전용법 없음 — 영국 유사 분야별 원칙기반(규제부담 상대적 낮음). 2024 프라이버시법 개정으로 ADM 고지·투명성 의무 도입 진행. 책임대출 입증이 사실상의 AI 거버넌스 게이트.
items.insight_en: No dedicated law like the EU AI Act — UK-like, principles-based by sector (relatively lower burden). The 2024 Privacy Act amendments introduce ADM notice/transparency. Responsible-lending evidencing is the de facto AI governance gate.

items.source: FCAI VFACTS / EV PROfiler / NVES Policy 2025
items.source_en: FCAI VFACTS / EV PROfiler / NVES Policy 2025
items.insight: 2025년 EV 점유 약 9% — Tesla Model Y·BYD 견인. NVES(연비규제 2025 시행)·EV FBT 면제가 가속. 2030년 30%대 전망.
items.insight_en: EV share ~9% in 2025 — led by Tesla Model Y and BYD. NVES (efficiency standard, 2025) and the EV FBT exemption accelerate adoption. ~30% projected by 2030.

items.source: Datium Insights / carsales Resale Data 2025
items.source_en: Datium Insights / carsales Resale Data 2025
items.insight: EV 3년 잔가가 ICE 대비 약 15pp 낮음 — 신모델 가격하락·Tesla 가격조정 영향. novated lease 잔가(GFV) 보수적 설계 필수.
items.insight_en: EV 3-yr residuals ~15pp below ICE — driven by new-model price drops and Tesla repricing. Conservative novated-lease residual (GFV) design essential.

items.value: 선진·안정·고소득 시장. 신차 ~120만대·높은 금융침투·통화/송금 리스크 최저(3대 트리플A)로 매력도 상위권. 핵심 차별점은 Toyota 부동의 1위와 novated lease(급여공제 리스) 채널의 독특한 발달 — FBT/salary-packaging 연동 상품이 진출 성공요인. 난이도는 ASIC ACL·NCCP 책임대출 인가가 관문이고 add-on insurance deferred sales 규제가 보험 부가수익을 차단하는 리스크 플래그. 4대 은행 부분 후퇴로 Pepper·Liberty 비은행과 Plenti·Wisr 핀테크에 진입 여지. 2025 NVES + EV FBT 면제로 EV+novated 결합이 최대 성장축이며 EV 잔가·ABS 프라임 풀 관리가 손익 변수. B2B chattel mortgage 무면허 즉시 진입 → ACL 취득 후 소비자 확장 전략 유효.
items.value_en: Advanced, stable, high-income market. ~1.2M new cars, high finance penetration, and lowest currency/remittance risk (triple-A from all three) put attractiveness in the upper tier. The differentiators are Toyota's unchallenged #1 position and the uniquely developed novated lease channel — FBT/salary-packaging-linked products are the success factor. Difficulty centers on ASIC ACL / NCCP responsible-lending authorisation, with add-on insurance deferred-sales rules a risk flag blocking ancillary insurance revenue. The big-four banks' partial retreat leaves room for non-banks (Pepper, Liberty) and fintechs (Plenti, Wisr). With the 2025 NVES and EV FBT exemption, EV+novated bundles are the top growth axis, with EV residuals and ABS prime-pool management as P&L variables. Strategy: enter unlicensed via B2B chattel mortgage, then expand to consumer after obtaining the ACL.
items.source: Synthesized from RBA, ASIC, FCAI, AFIA, ATO 2025
items.source_en: Synthesized from RBA, ASIC, FCAI, AFIA, ATO 2025
items.insight: 매력도 상위·게이트 전부 PASS의 베이스라인 시장. novated lease + 비은행/핀테크 + 보수적 EV 잔가 전략 권장.
items.insight_en: Baseline market with upper-tier attractiveness and all gates passing. Novated lease + non-bank/fintech + conservative EV residual strategy recommended.

items.source: FCAI VFACTS + EV PROfiler 2025
items.source_en: FCAI VFACTS + EV PROfiler 2025
items.insight: Toyota 부동의 1위. 한국계(Hyundai·Kia) 합산 ~12-13% 강한 입지. MG·BYD 중국계가 가장 빠른 성장축 — 캡티브/제휴 파트너 풀로 주목.
items.insight_en: Toyota the unchallenged #1. Korean brands (Hyundai, Kia) ~12-13% combined — strong footprint. Chinese MG/BYD are the fastest-growing axis — notable captive/partnership pool.

items.source: FCAI VFACTS 2025 (group-aggregated)
items.source_en: FCAI VFACTS 2025 (group-aggregated)
items.insight: Toyota 그룹 단독 ~20%. 한국 현대차그룹 2위(~12.5%)로 강세 — 캡티브 제휴 시 한국계 OEM 우선 타깃 가능.
items.insight_en: Toyota Group alone ~20%. Korea's Hyundai Motor Group is #2 (~12.5%) — Korean OEMs are a priority captive-partnership target.

items.source: Industry estimate (no official AU per-company share statistics) 2025
items.source_en: Industry estimate (no official AU per-company share statistics) 2025
items.insight: 호주는 회사별 공식 점유율 통계 부재 — 자산규모·인지도 기반 정성 순위. 4대 은행 소비자 딜러금융 부분 후퇴로 비은행·핀테크가 공백 흡수 중.
items.insight_en: Australia has no official per-company share statistics — qualitative ranking by asset size and recognition. The big-four banks' partial retreat from consumer dealer finance is being absorbed by non-banks and fintechs.

value: Mercedes-Benz Financial Services / BMW Australia Finance
items.source: ASX disclosures / Industry directory 2025
items.source_en: ASX disclosures / Industry directory 2025
items.insight: 캡티브·은행계·비은행·핀테크 다층 구조. novated lease 전문사(SG Fleet·Smartgroup·McMillan Shakespeare·Eclipx)가 salary-packaging 채널 지배.
items.insight_en: Multi-layered: captive, bank, non-bank, fintech. Novated-lease specialists (SG Fleet, Smartgroup, McMillan Shakespeare, Eclipx) dominate the salary-packaging channel.

items.value: 캡티브(Toyota Finance·VWFS·Mercedes/BMW FS) + 은행계 ADI(Macquarie·Westpac/St.George·NAB·CBA) + 독립 비은행 non-ADI(Pepper·Liberty·Latitude, ABS 증권화 조달) + 핀테크 디지털 렌더(Plenti·Wisr·MoneyMe) + novated lease 전문(SG Fleet·Smartgroup·McMillan Shakespeare·Eclipx). 외국사 단독 진출 가능.
items.value_en: Captives (Toyota Finance, VWFS, Mercedes/BMW FS) + bank ADIs (Macquarie, Westpac/St.George, NAB, CBA) + independent non-ADIs (Pepper, Liberty, Latitude, ABS-funded) + fintech digital lenders (Plenti, Wisr, MoneyMe) + novated-lease specialists (SG Fleet, Smartgroup, McMillan Shakespeare, Eclipx). Foreign solo entry feasible.
items.source: ASX disclosures / Industry research 2025
items.source_en: ASX disclosures / Industry research 2025
items.insight: novated lease는 호주 진출의 결정적 차별 포인트 — 단순 오토론 복제로는 시장 핵심을 놓침. FBT 연동 상품 모듈 필수.
items.insight_en: Novated lease is the decisive differentiator for Australian entry — a plain auto-loan copy misses the market core. An FBT-linked product module is essential.

items.value: 신차 secured 비교금리 약 6.5~10% (프라임 ~5.9~6.2%, 캡티브 프로모 0~3.9% 한정, 핀테크 위험기반 ~15%+). novated lease 실효 ~7~9%대. comparison rate 표기 의무.
items.value_en: New-car secured comparison rate ~6.5-10% (prime ~5.9-6.2%, captive promos 0-3.9% limited, fintech risk-based ~15%+). Novated lease effective ~7-9%. Comparison-rate disclosure mandatory.
items.source: Canstar / RBA Cash Rate / Industry pricing 2025
items.source_en: Canstar / RBA Cash Rate / Industry pricing 2025
items.insight: 은행/비은행 6.5~10%, 캡티브 프로모 최저, 핀테크 위험기반 상단. RBA 인하 사이클로 조달비용 하향 — 가격 경쟁 심화.
items.insight_en: Banks/non-banks 6.5-10%, captive promos lowest, fintech risk-based at the top. The RBA cut cycle lowers funding costs — intensifying price competition.

items.value: 약 AUD 55,000~60,000 (€33,000~36,000). ute·SUV 편중으로 단가 높음. EV·프리미엄 SUV가 상승 견인.
items.value_en: Approx. AUD 55,000-60,000 (€33,000-36,000). High ticket due to ute/SUV skew; EVs and premium SUVs push prices up.
items.source: FCAI / carsales Pricing Data 2025
items.source_en: FCAI / carsales Pricing Data 2025
items.insight: 평균 약 €34k — 유럽(€30k)보다 높음. ute(Ranger·HiLux)·대형 SUV 중심. 여신 단가·잔가 모델이 픽업/SUV 중심.
items.insight_en: Average ~€34k — above Europe (€30k). Centered on utes (Ranger, HiLux) and large SUVs. Ticket sizes and residual models are pickup/SUV-driven.

items.value: ASIC(시장행위·소비자신용 ACL·책임대출) / APRA(건전성·ADI) / RBA(중앙은행·결제) / ATO(세무·FBT) / FIRB(외국인투자) / ACCC(경쟁·소비자보호) / OAIC(프라이버시·CDR) / AUSTRAC(AML/CTF)
items.value_en: ASIC (market conduct, consumer credit ACL, responsible lending) / APRA (prudential, ADIs) / RBA (central bank, payments) / ATO (tax, FBT) / FIRB (foreign investment) / ACCC (competition, consumer protection) / OAIC (privacy, CDR) / AUSTRAC (AML/CTF).
items.source: ASIC / APRA / RBA / ATO / FIRB / ACCC / OAIC / AUSTRAC Official 2025
items.source_en: ASIC / APRA / RBA / ATO / FIRB / ACCC / OAIC / AUSTRAC Official 2025
items.insight: ASIC ACL 취득이 소비자 자동차금융 핵심 관문. 예금취급(ADI)은 APRA 별도. FIRB 외국인 심사 통과 필수. FBT(ATO)는 novated lease 세제 핵심.
items.insight_en: Obtaining the ASIC ACL is the key gate for consumer auto finance. Deposit-taking (ADI) sits separately under APRA. FIRB foreign-investment clearance is required. FBT (ATO) is central to novated-lease taxation.

value.headline: 호주 2025 신차 판매 약 120만대 — ute·SUV 편중 지속, Toyota·Ford Ranger 우위
value.headline_en: Australia 2025 new-car sales ~1.2M — ute/SUV skew persists, Toyota and Ford Ranger lead
value.so_what: 고차량가로 여신 단가 큼 — 캡티브 제휴 시 Toyota·Ford·한국계 우선 타깃.
value.so_what_en: High ticket sizes from expensive vehicles — Toyota, Ford, and Korean OEMs are priority captive-partnership targets.

value.headline: 호주 2026년 5월 전동화 판매 46% 돌파 — NVES 연비규제 페널티 본격화
value.headline_en: Australia electrified-vehicle sales pass 46% in May 2026 — NVES penalties take effect
value.so_what: EV 잔가 곡선 별도 모델링 필수. EV FBT 면제 + novated 결합이 전환 최대 촉매 — EV+novated 상품 성장 핵심.
value.so_what_en: Separate EV residual modeling essential. The EV FBT exemption plus novated bundling is the biggest catalyst — EV+novated products are the growth core.

value.headline: 호주 4대 은행 소비자 자동차 딜러금융 부분 후퇴 — 비은행·핀테크가 공백 흡수
value.headline_en: Australia's big-four banks partly retreat from consumer auto dealer finance — non-banks and fintechs absorb the gap
value.so_what: 비은행/캡티브/디지털 렌더 진입 여지 확대. novated lease 채널 장악이 진입 장벽이자 제휴 기회.
value.so_what_en: Expanded entry room for non-banks, captives, and digital lenders. Novated-lease channel dominance is both a barrier and a partnership opportunity.

value.headline: ASIC, add-on insurance(GAP·신용보험) 미스셀링 단속 강화·소비자 보상
value.headline_en: ASIC steps up enforcement on add-on insurance (GAP, credit insurance) mis-selling, with consumer remediation
value.so_what: 끼워팔기·add-on 마진 규제 강화 — UK PPI·DCA 흐름 유사. add-on 의존 수익모델 위험, 적합성·공정가치 컴플라이언스 선제 구축 필요.
value.so_what_en: Tighter tying/add-on margin rules — similar to the UK PPI/DCA trajectory. Add-on-dependent revenue models are risky; build suitability and fair-value compliance proactively.

value.headline: 호주 prime auto loan ABS 딜린퀀시 안정, 일부 니어프라임 풀 연체 소폭 상승
value.headline_en: Australia prime auto-loan ABS delinquencies stable; some near-prime pools tick up
value.so_what: 비은행 렌더 조달 핵심이 ABS 증권화 — 프라임 풀 우량 유지가 조달비용 좌우. 진입 초기 프라임 중심·니어프라임 보수 정책 권장.
value.so_what_en: Non-bank funding hinges on ABS securitization — prime-pool quality drives funding costs. Favor prime-centric, conservative near-prime policy at entry.

items.source: FCAI·Auto Finance News·ASIC·S&P (whitelist 2025-2026)
items.source_en: FCAI, Auto Finance News, ASIC, S&P (whitelist 2025-2026)
items.insight: EV 가속·은행 후퇴·add-on 규제 강화가 3대 이슈. 진입 여지는 넓으나 novated·EV·컴플라이언스 동시 설계 필요.
items.insight_en: EV acceleration, bank retreat, and tighter add-on rules are the three key issues. Entry room is broad, but novated, EV, and compliance must be designed in parallel.
